en.title: Delete Memory: The Vanishing Coordinates of the Festival Night
en.premise: In a hyper-connected metropolis, an urban legend is spreading: following a specific hashtag leads one into a physical 'void.' As the rumor gains traction on social media, it manifests 'Bugs'—anomalies that erode the very fabric of reality. A hacker, tracing the footsteps of his missing sister, ventures into a festival night where the abyss of the network and the physical 'Promised Hill' converge.

zh.title: Delete Memory：祭典之夜消失的坐标
zh.premise: 在一个高度网络化的都市中，流传着一个都市传说：只要追踪特定的标签，就会被引导至物理意义上的“空白”。随着传闻在社交媒体上的扩散，它正具现化出侵蚀现实空间的“Bug（怪异）”。主角是一名黑客，他循着失踪妹妹的足迹，踏入了网络深渊与物理上的“约定之丘”相互重叠的祭典之夜。
